name: DebateBench
description: DebateBench is a long-context reasoning benchmark consisting of transcripts and metadata from prestigious British Parliamentary competitive debates. It contains 256 speeches across 32 debates, each over 1 hour long with an average input of 32,000 tokens, annotated with detailed speech-level scores and house rankings from official adjudication.
reputation: Novel benchmark showing LLMs struggle with long-context debate reasoning
notes: Three evaluation tasks: Speech Scoring, Speech Ranking, and House Ordering; GPT o1, GPT-4o, and Claude Haiku all struggle on the benchmark; requires processing 32K+ token inputs.
